sections.title: Add an entry screen rule
sections.excerpt: Add an entry screen rule | Open the form to create a routing rule. Each rule matches a URL parameter value and routes the visitor to a start screen; rules are checked top to bottom and the first match wins.

sections.title: Remove a rule
sections.excerpt: Remove a rule | Delete a rule permanently; this cannot be undone. With no matching rule, the default start screen is used.

sections.title: Specify the value to match
sections.excerpt: Specify the value to match | Enter the exact value the parameter must have to trigger the rule. The match is case-sensitive (for example, enter summer for utm_campaign=summer).

sections.title: Choose the URL parameter to match
sections.excerpt: Choose the URL parameter to match | Select a parameter you defined in Sources. Its key is read from the incoming URL (for example utm_campaign) when the funnel loads.

sections.title: Choose the start screen
sections.excerpt: Choose the start screen | Pick the V2 step where matching visitors land; it must exist in the selected onboarding version. Saved visitor progress overrides rules.

sections.title: Enable or disable the rule
sections.excerpt: Enable or disable the rule | Toggle a rule active or inactive. Disabled rules are kept but skipped at load, which is useful for testing or temporary pauses.
